metric_descriptions.paper_modulus_mae: Primary paper-style far-field modulus L1. Lower is better.
metric_descriptions.relative_l1_modulus: Scale-normalized far-field L1. Lower is better.
metric_descriptions.chi2_modulus: Paper chi-square style far-field error. Lower is better.
metric_descriptions.pearson_corr: Far-field Pearson correlation. Higher is better.
metric_descriptions.relative_log_mse: Log-domain far-field diagnostic. Lower is better.
metric_descriptions.voxel_mse: Raw far-field MSE on the current data scale. Lower is better.
metric_descriptions.voxel_rmse: Raw far-field RMSE on the current data scale. Lower is better.
metric_descriptions.real_amp_l1: Real-space full-volume amplitude L1. Lower is better, but can be small for sparse objects.
metric_descriptions.real_amp_mse: Real-space full-volume amplitude MSE. Lower is better.
metric_descriptions.real_amp_rmse: Real-space full-volume amplitude RMSE. Lower is better.
metric_descriptions.real_amp_global_ssim: Global 3D amplitude SSIM-like score. Higher is better.
metric_descriptions.real_support_iou: Intersection-over-union between predicted and true support. Higher is better.
metric_descriptions.real_support_dice: Dice score between predicted and true support. Higher is better.
metric_descriptions.real_support_true_fraction: True support fraction in the 64^3 volume.
metric_descriptions.real_support_pred_fraction: Predicted support fraction in the 64^3 volume; should be close to true fraction.
metric_descriptions.real_phase_mae_true_support: Wrapped phase MAE on the true support. Lower is better.
metric_descriptions.real_phase_mae_intersection: Wrapped phase MAE on support intersection. Lower is better.
metric_descriptions.real_phase_rmse_true_support: Wrapped phase RMSE on the true support. Lower is better.

metric_notes.paper_modulus_mae: Paper Eq. (1): MAE of diffraction modulus because stored tensors are abs(FFT).
metric_notes.chi2_modulus: Paper Eq. (2): reciprocal-space chi2 of diffraction modulus.
metric_notes.real_amp_global_ssim: Single-window 3D SSIM-like amplitude score, not local-window skimage SSIM.
